Since all these riots started I never visited Annalie.
I hope she’s ok…
When I’m walking down the street I see many shops pillaged, some even burnt down.
I would want to think that her business was unharmed in all this chaos, that people would spare her since she’s such a nice, hardworking girl, but gradually I’m losing the rest of my faith in humanity.
I’m getting closer now…
Oh no.
It’s a sad view, really.
All the windows are broken and the insides look empty. Even hangers were stolen, probably because it was faster to take the clothes with them.
Why is this happening…
